sections.1-1-why-this-chapter-comes-first: Kitab ka har chapter inhi aath qadmon par chalta hai. Inhein yahan seekh lein to har condition chapter aasaani se samajh aayega.
sections.1-2-key-words-learn-these-first: Pehle yeh alfaaz samjhein: finding (jo dekha ya napa), clinical clue (jo kisi taraf ishara kare), working diagnosis (abhi ka behtareen andaza) aur red flag (khatre ki nishani).
sections.1-3-the-eight-steps: Aath qadam: typical presentation pehchano, pehle serious conditions screen karo, sawaal poocho, examine karo, tests karo, doosri conditions alag karo, working diagnosis banao, aur plan aur reassessment karo.
sections.1-4-three-levels-of-urgency: Urgency ke teen level: emergency (jaan ya bare kaam ko khatra, foran), urgent (jaldi medical review) aur routine (aam physio care).
sections.1-5-symptom-reproduction-is-not-diagnosi: Agar test se dard wapas aaye to sirf itna pata chalta hai ke woh hissa sensitive hai. Is se diagnosis sabit nahi hota.
sections.now-you-should-be-able-to: Yeh checklist hai. Har point khud kar sakein to tick karein.
